This is a [NeoIPC Surveillance](https://neoipc.org/surveillance/)<!-- --> analysis of infection rates in your neonatal department, presented alongside reference data from the NeoIPC Surveillance network to support benchmarking and identification of areas for further review.

The following summary presents key surveillance metrics for this report. A patient record represents an individual patient; patient admissions count separately each admission episode during the surveillance period. Rates in this report use different denominators depending on the metric; each table's formula footnote specifies the exact denominator used.
